evidence.quote: If you are running EMR clusters using EC2 On-Demand Instances, EMR Serverless will offer a lower total cost of ownership (TCO) if your current cluster utilization is less than 70%. If you are using the EC2 Savings Plans, EMR Serverless will offer a lower TCO if your current cluster utilization is less than 50%. And if you use EC2 Spot Instances, Amazon EMR on EC2 and Amazon EMR on EKS will continue to be more cost effective.

claim: Compared with EMR Serverless: if you run EMR clusters on EC2 On-Demand Instances, EMR Serverless offers a lower total cost of ownership (TCO) if your cluster utilization is less than 70%; with EC2 Savings Plans, if utilization is less than 50%; and if you use EC2 Spot Instances, Amazon EMR on EC2 and Amazon EMR on EKS continue to be more cost effective.

qualifiers.scope: cost of EMR Serverless compared with EMR on EC2 and EMR on EKS
